rule_trace: waterhemp: zero tolerance; present at 2 of 2 stops -> treat
Treat mode: broadcast (treated species at 100% of stops, mean weed cover 12.5%)
explanation: Found waterhemp in soybean at 2 of 2 stops with mean cover 12.52 percent and max height 12.0 in. Because waterhemp has zero tolerance and was present at 100 percent of stops, the decision is to treat with a broadcast application. Urgency is Treat within ~3 days (12 in, label limit 12 in). Among options weigh herbicide groups and trait requirements. Roundup PowerMAX 3 is group 9 and requires glyphosate-tolerant trait and allows up to 12.0 in. FLEXSTAR is group 14 with no trait required. Engenia Herbicide is group 4 and requires dicamba-tolerant trait. Enlist One, LIBERTY 280 SL HERBICIDE and COBRA HERBICIDE are over size limit. Read the label before use.
